name: Eli Jaxon-Bear
reason: Own-site robots block: his Leela School site (leelaschool.org, which carries his events calendar, online membership and mentoring packages) has a robots.txt group 'User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: /' (read 5 Nov 2026), so under the owner's 5 Nov rule it is off limits and the teacher is skipped. His foundation site leela.org allows us (office email leigh@leela.org in its footer, Ashland, Oregon), but nothing was taken from the blocked site; the owner may decide whether leela.org alone could support a listing.
